Hello,

I saw your opening for a Product Designer at ServiceNow and wanted to connect, particularly given your focus on building workflows that free people from busywork.

My background combines a computer science degree with practical design execution. At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable visual systems and templates that cut turnaround times across digital and print collateral. Previously at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability.

My B2B case study, Bounceless, demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams managing complex email lists. You can view it on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Based in Nagpur, I am ready to relocate to Hyderabad for this role. Would you be open to a brief look at my Bounceless case study?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
